scope: first 40 source IDs, printed page 979, block 2
status: proposal only; not applied or independently reviewed

lexical_refs.note: to risk one's life; entry quotes this Seytek phrase
outstanding; entry quotes the Tooqyzyl line
to act aggressively or toss one's body in challenge
chain mail; quoted formula for double mail with lark-eye rings
spirea shrub with hard wood; burning-ember armor formula
parallel epic diction; not treated as a replacement for the 2012 source

uncertainty: Lines 19-25 have discontinuous syntax in the 2012 extraction; the proposed English keeps each source row's words without imposing a confident causal reconstruction.
Line 35 appears to quote Kanykey speaking about armor, but speaker and addressee should be checked against the preceding passage.
Line 36's subject is unstated; the proposed wording avoids naming one.
Line 40's plant is rendered spirea following the dictionary; the armor formula has multiple epic variants.

corrections.en: Not reckoning that he might die.
corrections.reason: Өлөмүн деп санабай says he does not count on his own death, continuing Sarybay's heedlessness.

corrections.en: A fierce clash began.
corrections.reason: Катуу кагыш denotes a hard clash or battle, not just a sound.

corrections.en: The life that Almighty God bestowed,
corrections.reason: Кадыр Алда is an epithet of Allah; берген жан is the bestowed life. See lexical reference.

corrections.old: He tied it to the grass.
corrections.en: He staked upon a single hair.
corrections.reason: Кылга байлап таштады is an idiom for risking one's life. The dictionary quotes this Seytek line.

corrections.en: The wretch had worked himself into a frenzy,
corrections.reason: Жээликкен is excited or goaded; кутургур is a disparaging epithet, not a second 'crazy.'

corrections.old: Blowing the face of the earth,
corrections.en: Making the face of the earth bristle,
corrections.reason: Үрпөйтүп is causative of bristle or ruffle, not blowing.

corrections.en: Tooqyzyl, the outstanding swift horse,
corrections.reason: Жетик is outstanding; күлүк is a swift horse. Preserve the horse name used on preceding page.

corrections.en: Urging it into a racing gallop,
corrections.reason: Желиктирип чуратып, likely чуркатып in the parallel edition, concerns driving a horse to run; extraction or edition spelling merits check.

corrections.old: Hitting the face of the earth
corrections.en: Tearing up the face of the earth,
corrections.reason: Уратып is causative of breaking or bringing down, describing the horse's forceful gallop.

corrections.old: Kuyaly, if it is his turn,
corrections.en: If Kuyaly were given her turn,
corrections.reason: Кезегин берсе is giving a turn; Kuyaly is the female warrior, not 'his.'

corrections.en: Such is her agility.
corrections.reason: Шамдагайы is her agility or swiftness, not a proper name.

corrections.en: Toward Kuyaly
corrections.reason: Карата means toward or aimed at in this action context.

corrections.en: Sarybay, swaggering defiantly,
corrections.reason: Кулжуңдаган describes aggressive, challenging motion; it is not a name.

corrections.en: Drew his bow, sending arrows like rain,
corrections.reason: Жаа тартып is drawing and shooting a bow; жамгыр кылып supplies the rain simile.

corrections.en: Firing shots like hail,
corrections.reason: Мөндүр кылып ок атып is an ongoing description of Sarybay's hail-like shooting.

corrections.old: If he does it, shoot six,
corrections.en: With a stratagem, firing six at a time,
corrections.reason: Айла is stratagem or device; алты атып is shooting six. Exact gun mechanism uncertain.

corrections.en: A matchlock gun was on his back,
corrections.reason: Милте мылтык is a matchlock gun; жонунда places it on his back.

corrections.old: Bat Atar has a lot in hand.
corrections.en: Many quick-firing guns were in his hands.
corrections.reason: Бат атар means quick-shooting, not a person's name; колдо далай бар means many in hand. Weapon noun is implied from preceding line.

corrections.en: With this he fired a hundred shots,
corrections.reason: Муну менен жүз атып explicitly counts one hundred shots; keep its hyperbolic count.

corrections.en: Before its bullet could reach,
corrections.reason: Анын огу is its bullet or shot; жеткиче is until it reaches. Object is deferred or omitted.

corrections.old: Suddenly, blood came out of the lion,
corrections.en: Blood flowed from the lionhearted warrior,
corrections.reason: Кабылан шер is a feline heroic epithet; кан чыгып means blood came out. No 'suddenly.'

corrections.en: Before it reached the very crown of the head,
corrections.reason: Как төбө is the very top or crown; not 'Kak' or a building ceiling. Syntactic referent remains uncertain.

corrections.en: A polished arrow toward the shoulder,
corrections.reason: Сыр жебе is a polished arrow; айдалыга marks the shoulder as destination. No negation or eating.

corrections.en: If one were to tell the tale,
corrections.reason: Айта берсе аңгеме is conditional, perhaps a narrator's parenthesis.

corrections.en: With it he fired a hundred shots,
corrections.reason: Аны менен жүз атып again counts a hundred shots, likely referring to the preceding weapon.

corrections.en: The swaggering wretch,
corrections.reason: Жагалданган describes swaggering or displaying oneself; кутургур is a contemptuous epithet.

corrections.en: Drew his bow, sending arrows like rain,
corrections.reason: Жаа is bow, not rainbow; rain is a metaphor for volume of arrows.

corrections.en: Firing other shots like hail,
corrections.reason: Бөлөк means other or separate; preserve it in the shooting image.

corrections.en: While his shots fell all around,
corrections.reason: Огу каптап турганда refers to shots blanketing or enveloping the scene, not a covered bullet.

corrections.en: Kayypchal's valiant daughter,
corrections.reason: Кайран кыз is an admiring epithet for Kuyaly; maintain affiliation with Kayypchal.

corrections.en: Sensing the turmoil,
corrections.reason: Уйгу-туйгу means disorder or turmoil, not sleep; түшүнүп is perceiving or understanding.

corrections.en: As she turned this way and that,
corrections.reason: Оң-тетири is right and reverse/opposite, describing evasive movement here; no moral judgment.

corrections.en: There was wonder in the work she made,
corrections.reason: Кылган иште сонун бар states there is something remarkable in the crafted work; next line names Kanykey.

corrections.en: The valiant Kanykey,
corrections.reason: Берендиги is heroic or valiant, not a name; Kanykey is standard name form.

corrections.old: If you face, wear a scarf -
corrections.en: 'Wear it when you face the foe,' she said,
corrections.reason: Жоо is foe, not scarf; кийгин is imperative 'put it on.' Object is the armor described below.

corrections.en: When facing that foe,
corrections.reason: Ошо жоону караса explicitly refers to looking toward or facing the foe; subject is unstated.

corrections.en: If Father Khizr wills it,
corrections.reason: Кызыр ата is the holy Khizr figure, not 'red father'; кааласа is if he wishes.

corrections.old: The collar is gold, the sleeves are copper
corrections.en: Its collar was gold, its sleeves copper,
corrections.reason: Armor description; existing literal nouns substantially right, clarify possessive and parallel syntax.

corrections.en: Double mail with rings like lark's eyes,
corrections.reason: Кош бадана is double chain mail; торгой көз describes tiny lark-eye rings. Dictionary quotes the formula.

corrections.old: If the find is good, it will not pass.
corrections.en: Even burning spirea embers could not pierce it,
corrections.reason: Табылгы is spirea shrub, жакса means if lit, чок is ember, өтпөс means would not pass through; armor formula.
